_comment: Hand-authorised rewrites (Ivan) for names OPSIN cannot read as extracted: the SPAN in the corpus stays verbatim, this only decides which structure the name stands for. structures.py loads these into REWRITE (a rewrite outranks the OCR repair). Each carries its reason. Added 2026-10-03.
